shorts.title: Vampire Bats Don't Suck Blood (They Do Something Weirder) 🦇
shorts.description:
Vampire bats don't suck blood. They make a tiny cut, and lap it up with their tongue. A vampire bat can die after about 70 hours without a meal, which is why roostmates share.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.comment: Creepier or cuter than you thought? 👇

shorts.title: Black Widows Usually Don't Eat Their Mates 🕷️
shorts.description:
Black widows usually don't eat their mates. In the western black widow, it's never been seen in the wild. In a few Southern Hemisphere widow species, eating the male is the norm. Not this one.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Latrodectus hesperus: Cricket Raspet (CC BY), crseaquist (CC BY), Andrew Meeds (CC BY), dhasdf (CC BY), Katrina Smith (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Who told you the black widow always eats the male? 👇

shorts.title: Black Cats Are Good Luck in Japan and Scotland 🐈‍⬛
shorts.description:
Black cats aren't bad luck everywhere. In Japan and Scotland, a black cat means good luck. In Scotland, a strange black cat on your doorstep is said to bring prosperity.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Felis catus: CC0, Andrew Conboy (CC BY), Tyler Ekholm (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Good luck or bad luck where you live? 👇

shorts.title: Crows Really Do Gather Around Their Dead 🐦‍⬛
shorts.description:
Crows really do gather around a dead crow. But it's not a funeral. It's a lesson about danger. Crows ignored a dead pigeon. Only a dead crow set them off.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Corvus brachyrhynchos: CC0, Anthony Batista (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Has a crow ever held a grudge against you? 👇

shorts.title: Owls Aren't Death Omens, But They Can Fly in Silence 🦉
shorts.description:
Owls aren't omens of death. But they really can fly almost without a sound. Engineers have copied the owl's feather comb to make wind turbines quieter.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.comment: Have you ever heard an owl fly over? 👇

shorts.title: No Spider Lays Eggs in Your Skin (Here's Where They Go) 🕷️
shorts.description:
No spider lays its eggs in your skin. There's no real case in medical records. Not one. The legend may trace partly to a 1982 horror novel, but it's older than that.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths
